title: AI Voice & Chat Agents
subtitle: Assistants that listen, reason and get real work done
description: Voice and chat agents that use your tools and your documents to finish tasks, with approvals and logs so you stay in control. We shipped Nira, a voice assistant, for Nirman Labs.
useCases: A voice assistant for students, customers or reception desks
A chat assistant that answers from your own documents
An agent that books, files, searches and updates your systems
An internal helper that saves staff hours every week
features: Real-time voice you can interrupt (Gemini Live, Whisper)
Chat assistants with streaming answers and file attachments
Answers from your own documents (RAG) instead of guesses
Tool-using agents that call your APIs and MCP connectors
Multi-language support, including Hindi and English
Memory and personalisation across sessions
deliverables: A working agent with an agreed scope and toolset
Test questions and quality checks to measure answers
Human approval for risky actions, plus run logs
Cost and usage tracking per user or team
Documentation and full source handover

process.name: Launch and improve
process.detail: Go live, watch usage and cost, and keep refining.

title: Desktop Apps & Automation
subtitle: Windows apps that listen, see the screen and get work done
description: Windows desktop software and tools: voice assistants that control the computer, background utilities with hotkeys, and automation that works through the screen like a person would.
useCases: A voice assistant that works your computer for you
A background tool that runs on a hotkey and fills in work automatically
Hands-free control with a webcam or a microphone
An internal Windows tool that replaces repetitive manual work
features: Windows desktop apps in Python, with Tkinter or Qt interfaces
Voice input and output, online (Gemini Live, Whisper) or offline (Windows speech)
Screen and webcam vision, so the app can see what you see
Computer-use automation: mouse, keyboard, windows and point-and-click by description
Global hotkeys, tray and background operation
Installers, code signing and automatic updates

Full source code and build documentation
Safety guardrails: emergency stop, confirmations and logs
Setup and troubleshooting guide for your team
Support for Windows 10 and 11

title: Cyber Security
subtitle: Find the weak spots before someone else does
description: Security reviews, penetration testing and hardening for your websites, apps and cloud setup, with a clear report of what is wrong, how serious it is and how to fix it.
useCases: A security check of your website or web app before launch
A review of an Android app, an API or a cloud setup
Hardening a server, network or office setup after an incident or scare
Secure-coding and access-control review for an app we or you built
features: Web and API testing against the OWASP Top 10: injection, broken access control, weak authentication and more
Android and Windows app review, including insecure storage, exposed keys and weak update channels
Cloud and server configuration review for AWS: permissions, open ports, secrets and backups
Network and Wi-Fi checks: exposed services, weak setups and segmentation gaps
Dependency and secrets scanning in your code and CI pipeline
Security basics for your team: password hygiene, access rules and phishing awareness
deliverables: A written report with every finding ranked by severity
Proof of each issue, so your team can reproduce it
Fix guidance in plain steps, and help applying it if you want
A retest after fixes, to confirm they work
A short summary for non-technical owners and managers

process.name: Agree the scope
process.detail: Decide what is tested, what is off limits and when, in writing.

process.name: Map the surface
process.detail: List the pages, APIs, apps, servers and accounts an attacker could reach.

process.name: Test safely
process.detail: Manual and tool-based testing, without harming live data or users.

process.name: Report
process.detail: Findings ranked by severity, with proof and plain-language fixes.

process.name: Fix and retest
process.detail: Support while you fix, then retest and confirm the issues are closed.
